description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Amended Extra Gazette No.2314/16 Dated January 11,2023, By Substitution of the Schedule Effective from March 07,2024
reasoning: This gazette notification involves the amendment of a schedule in the Finance Act, No. 25 of 2003, which is a legal/regulatory action. It is an order made under statutory powers to modify existing regulations (specifically, departure fees for travelers). While it is signed by a named minister, the core content is about modifying a legal instrument and its provisions, not about government personnel changes or structural reorganization. Therefore, it falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5).
